title: Pineapple Square Pattern #S-741
author: J. & P. Coats / Clark's (vintage leaflet, via Free Vintage Crochet)
notes: Vintage thread motif (First Motif, rnds 1-11): circle of tr, chain loops, then 12 small pineapples (3 per side). start: original 'Starting at center, ch 10. Join with sl st to form ring.' replaced by magic ring. Rounds were one paragraph ('1st rnd: ... 2nd rnd: ...'), split onto 'Round N:' lines. Second-motif joining and edging omitted. No stated counts. Rnd 7 transcribed literally ('(sc in next sp, ch 3) 5 times; ch 4, skip next sp'), although a symmetric reading would put the 6th sc in the last ch-1 sp. Unstated skips (e.g. to the centre dc in Rnd 4) are left implicit in the DSL. Stitch graph: round 9 reads badly (cost 30.0); check where its stitches go.
